name: Convert
summary: Privacy-first A/B testing platform — experiments, personalization and feature rollouts, priced by tested users. Via our link: an exclusive 30-day full-access trial (standard is 15 days).
best_for: CRO teams running serious A/B and multivariate testing who want a privacy-first, GDPR-friendly alternative to the big experimentation suites
skip_if: your traffic is modest — statistical significance needs volume, and 100K tested users a month is more than most small sites can use — or your landing-page tool's built-in testing covers it
honest_knock: The meter is tested users, and it keeps running: blow past your monthly allowance and overuse blocks land at $399-699 unless you hard-cap them — and every extra custom domain is $1,000 a year. The friendly $299 headline assumes annual prepay; month-to-month is $399. One thing people misprice, and it is not the test itself: everyone expects an experiment to end when the subscription does. The trap is the winner. Convert describes itself as a client-side tool where “adding just one snippet of code on your site will then do all of the magic”. So a winning variant you leave running in the visual editor is not a change to your site — it is a rendering by their script. Ship the winner into your own code, or you are paying rent on a result you already bought.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-09-20 on convert.com/pricing) 15-day standard free trial — through our link it's an exclusive 30-day full-access trial (verified 16 Jul 2026, no credit card). Growth $399/mo, or $299/mo paid annually ($3,588/yr, which the page calls a 25% saving); Pro $599/mo, or $420/mo paid annually ($5,040/yr, a 30% saving); Enterprise on request, annual only. Tested users are a slider rather than a plan feature: at the base position Growth AND Pro both include 100K tested users a month (1.2M a year), and Enterprise starts at 1M a month (12M a year). The tiers differ on limits — active projects 5 / 30 / unlimited, active experiences per project 5 / unlimited / unlimited, active domains 10 / unlimited / unlimited, goals per project 30 / 100 / 200, custom segments 5 / 10 / 20, deploys 10 / 100 / 300 — and Growth is marked absent on multipage, multivariate and full-stack testing, multi-arm bandit allocation, geotargeting, weather targeting, custom pop-ups and the beta request-approval system. Overuse is metered at $399 per extra 100K on Growth and $699 per 250K on Pro and Enterprise, and can be switched off; each additional custom domain (CNAME) costs $1,000/year. Prices exclude VAT and GST. Native heatmaps and frustration-sensing session recordings are included at every tier at no extra cost and do not consume tested users; 8% of the annual fee goes to tree planting with TIST.
